common_assay_conditions.MIC: MH broth microdilution; 96-well plate; 2-fold serial dilutions from MLE-15 200 µg/mL or reline 50% v/v; final inoculum approx. 2 x 10^5 cells; 18 h at 37 C; MIC defined as lowest concentration completely inhibiting visible growth.
common_assay_conditions.planktonic_colony_count: LB-grown cells to OD600 0.5, washed, approx. 10^7 cells, treated at 1xMIC for 1.5 h at 37 C, serially diluted and plated on LB agar for 24 h; result expressed as log CFU/mL or log-unit reduction.
common_assay_conditions.biofilm_colony_count: 24 h biofilm in microtiter/chamber format, treated for 3 h at 37 C; MLE-15 prepared in 20 mM HEPES pH 7.4 and reline in saline; harvested, serially diluted, plated on LB agar for 24 h; result expressed as log CFU/mL or log-unit reduction.
common_assay_conditions.persister: A. baumannii RUH134 in LB at 37 C; time-course colony counts expressed as log CFU/mL; meropenem 10xMIC used for persister induction where specified.
common_assay_conditions.statistics: Experiments duplicated in three independent trials (n=6); one-way ANOVA; p<0.05 considered significant; error bars represent standard deviation where plotted.
